title: Singari Bangari
desc: Singari and Bangari are best friends who always support each other. However, when Singari becomes a victim of child abuse and suffers mental trauma, Bangari vows to help him recover.

title: Solillada Saradara
desc: Krishna, a ferry driver, is about to marry Rukmini, the love of his life. However, things take a turn when a landlord's daughter falls for him.

title: Real Police
desc: Residents rejoice when an honest policeman arrives in their town. However, the policeman's latest case proves to be more challenging than he expected.

title: Sakshatkara
desc: Bhoopalan, a rich man, wishes to get his son, Mahesh, married to his friend's daughter, Uma. However, Mahesh's uncle has an eye on their wealth and conspires to get his daughter married to him.

title: Karaali
desc: A woman endeavours to reunite with the man she loves. However, circumstances take a dramatic turn when she finds herself battling a demon.
